_doc: Collection-memory scenarios for memory_bench.py. Each scenario runs in a fresh collection X (and, when a step says collection 'other', a second fresh collection Y). Every step is one prompt sent to a NEW session unless it names the same session as the previous step. Checks run after the last step. answer_re / answer_not_re apply to that step's answer; memory checks apply to collection X's memories (GET /api/collections/X/memories).
